title: roammate vs Tourlina: Which Travel Companion App Is Right for You?
description: Tourlina connects women travelers exclusively while roammate matches all travelers by style, budget, and destination. Here's how to decide which one fits your needs.
intro: If you're searching for a travel companion app, you've probably come across both roammate and Tourlina. They both help travelers find people to explore with — but they take fundamentally different approaches. Tourlina is a women-only platform designed specifically for female travelers who want to connect with other women. roammate is open to all travelers and matches based on travel style, budget bracket, and destination overlap. Neither approach is inherently better — it depends on what you're looking for. This comparison breaks down the real differences so you can pick the right tool.

sections.heading: How Tourlina and roammate Differ
sections.content: Tourlina's core proposition is safety through exclusivity: only women can join, and the platform is built around the idea that female travelers feel more comfortable connecting with other women. If you're a woman who exclusively wants to travel with other women, Tourlina delivers on that promise. The platform lets you browse profiles by destination and send connection requests. Tourlina offers a free tier with limited features and a premium subscription that unlocks additional functionality like seeing who viewed your profile and sending unlimited messages. roammate takes a different approach entirely. Instead of filtering by gender, roammate filters by compatibility. The matching algorithm considers travel style (adventure, cultural immersion, slow travel, food-focused), daily budget bracket, and destination overlap before surfacing profiles. This means you're not scrolling through everyone heading to Lisbon — you're seeing people whose pace, spending habits, and interests actually align with yours. roammate is free on iOS and Android with no premium tier or subscription required. The platform is open to all travelers regardless of gender, which means a larger pool of potential companions and more destination coverage, particularly in regions outside Europe and North America where Tourlina's user base thins out considerably.

sections.heading: Which One Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose Tourlina if you are a woman who specifically wants to travel only with other women, and you're willing to pay for premium features to improve the experience. Tourlina's gender-exclusive model provides a layer of comfort that matters to many female travelers, particularly those heading to destinations where solo female travel carries additional safety considerations. Choose roammate if you want the deepest compatibility matching regardless of gender — if what matters most is finding someone who matches your travel pace, budget, and interests rather than demographic filters. roammate's algorithm-driven approach means less time scrolling and more time connecting with people who genuinely fit your travel style. The free model also means no friction to getting started.
